scope: Observed quick-effort planning on the unchanged ten-program corpus with a frozen compiler and planner; not performance evidence
baseline: Same knowledge sources and canonical snapshot with only producers.v8_word_laws removed from the catalog; private publications
interpretation: No V8 patterns matched the initial programs directly. Later generic planning admitted u32/branch_condition_value for ast-ancestor, which retained the baseline after the measurement-budget gate. No V8 law was observed in multiple held-out programs. Both runs compiled all ten programs and selected one alternative, on different programs; these shared-machine, time-bounded search differences are not performance evidence.
limitations: Shared machine and simultaneous isolated runs; planning durations are diagnostics, not compiler-performance benchmarks
All programs exhausted their quick planning time budget
